item.title: Squeak 2.34.6
item.description:
One bar with tabs, a calmer Room, and ducks that choose their own streams.

  • One bar on every page: the pond's logo and name, the Dashboard | Room switch, then tabs. Each duck is a low oval tab showing what its chat is for and what it's doing right now; files, diffs and artifacts open as tabs beside them. Inside a duck the bar stays put, with the duck's streams, commit and PR controls just below it.
  • The Room reads like a group chat: whole messages in flat rows, each task as one card that updates in place, and an unread line. Tap a message or a duck to open its chat at that moment. Ducks write short Room updates themselves; status chatter stays in their own chats.
  • Ducks start in the pond and open, join or leave streams themselves, even two at once. Their streams show under the bar and in Changes. Main stays read-only for ducks.
  • Duck names are short, many with an Indian touch, and never have a number. A duck gives its name back when it goes off duty; off-duty ducks are listed by what their chat was for. Chats get clear titles once their work is clear.
  • The Files, Changes, Artifacts and Tasks lists on the right open at once.
  • If a duck's stream folder is gone, its chat says so and offers Return to the Pond, instead of a confusing error.
  • Fewer buttons: every control has a reason to be there.

Also in 2.34.5

One rail, one top bar, and things open as tabs.

  • Every page (Dashboard, Room and each duck) has the same tools on the right: Changes, Files, Artifacts, Tasks, Notebook and Terminal. Changes, Files, Artifacts and Tasks open a short list; pick something and it opens as a tab. Terminal opens beside the chat.
  • The pond's name, the Dashboard | Room switch, your ducks (as circles) and open tabs share one bar at the top. Open tabs belong to the pond and come back after a restart. ⌘1–9 jump to a tab, ⌃Tab cycles, ⌘W closes the current one.
  • Changes on the Dashboard and in the Room lists every duck's changed files, grouped by duck. "Review all from Pip" opens a duck's whole change set, with merge and pull request controls; "Ask Pip to fix…" sends a note to that duck.
  • An artifact opens full size with one header and one Export menu. Zoom with ⌘= / ⌘- / ⌘0.
  • Open tabs update when a duck changes them; a dot marks one that changed while you were elsewhere. If a branch is merged or a file is removed, its tab says so instead of vanishing.
  • Reply in the Room quotes a message and mentions who said it.
  • The / list shows all your skills, including ones from plugins such as mattpocock-skills; typing part of a name finds it.
  • Archived chats are now off-duty ducks, and the sidebar no longer has an Archived section.

Also in 2.34.4

The Room is a chat.

  • Messages sit in bubbles: yours on the right in the pond's colour, people and ducks on the left with their picture and name. A run of messages from one sender is grouped under one name.
  • Status lines ("finished", "took it") are small centred lines; a duck's run of them folds into one ("Ruby 2 · 4 updates"). Tasks show as cards.
  • Click a duck's picture or name anywhere in the Room to open its chat.
  • Show more appears only when a message is really cut off, and a clamped message no longer shows half a line.
  • The Room has no side panel. Its icon rail opens the pond's Files, Artifacts and Terminal beside the chat.
  • Switching between Dashboard and Room keeps the header still and only moves the page below.
  • The @ and / lists open as a small list just above the box, starting at the character you typed.
  • Esc steps back: closes a list or pane, then goes from a duck's chat to the Room, then to the Dashboard. It no longer leaves full screen.
